summary.text: Ben Hightower is the Republican candidate for Maryland State Senate District 9 in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which incumbent Katie Fry Hester (D) is also running.
A U.S. Navy veteran who works in healthcare administration, he advanced from the June 23, 2026 Republican primary.

paragraphs.text: Hightower served in the U.S. Navy from 2002 to 2022, earned a bachelor's degree from Southern Illinois University, Carbondale in 2021 and a graduate degree from John Brown University in 2023, and has worked in healthcare administration.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he served as a Hospital Corpsman and retired after 20 years of service.

Hightower's three campaign messages in the survey were cutting taxes and regulatory burdens, supporting schools by empowering parents and rewarding teachers, and backing law enforcement and first responders; he also named conservation and farming as priorities.
